scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/tokenomics && tsc -p packages/deploy && tsc -p packages/monetary && tsc -p packages/payments && tsc -p packages/provider && tsc -p packages/zk && tsc -p packages/sdk
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.check:contracts: cd contracts && forge fmt --check && forge build --sizes --skip test --skip script && forge test && cd .. && node scripts/check-token-abi.mjs
scripts.coverage:contracts: cd contracts && forge coverage --report summary --no-match-coverage "test|lib|script" && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=zk forge coverage --report summary --no-match-coverage "test|lib|zk/"
